L1o.name: The Sovereign Core
L1o.goal: Standalone intelligence with clean logic; deterministic/formally verified instruction set, SSOT memory, self-reflective success schemas, auto-audit.

Lo3.name: The Swarm Governor
Lo3.goal: Control and extract value from external AI while preventing hallucination through decomposition, adversarial attack, judging, sandboxing and evidence.

Lo2.name: The Singularity Hub
Lo2.goal: Synthesize verified success patterns/results into logic artifacts and laws, with traceability and distribution back to L1o/Lo3.

L1o.name: Sovereign Core (L600)
L1o.core_goal: Produce only provable, bounded-correct outputs under strict constraints.

Lo3.name: Swarm Governor (L600)
Lo3.core_goal: Force unreliable AI systems to produce verifiable truth under control.
Lo3.final_insight: A system that destroys wrong answers until only survivors remain.

Lo2.name: Singularity Core (L600)
Lo2.core_goal: Continuously synthesize, refine, and evolve provable logic laws from global verified interactions.
Lo2.input_rule: Reject unverified input; does not consume raw user data.
Lo2.final_insight: A machine that turns experience into laws.

L1o.responsibility: Bounded, provable deterministic logic under constraints; canonicalization, constraints, dependency-graph reasoning, multi-path generation/pruning, recursive audit and verified-state flow.

Lo3.responsibility: External-model orchestration, task decomposition, context sharding, adversarial attack, consensus/proof verification, trust evolution and controlled output.

Lo2.responsibility: Consume verified success schemas/results, extract logic quanta, resolve conflicts, synthesize/evolve laws, maintain traceability, version and distribute validated updates.

authority_and_interpretation_rules: These observations describe architecture terminology from the authoritative design file.
Within the same design file, later L600 and FINAL ABSOLUTE ARCHITECTURE sections are treated as refinements of earlier terminology when wording differs.
Architecture terminology does not override higher-priority DOC-B/DOC-C current-build law, scope registry, verified implementation state, or current tests.
Statements in the design file are design requirements/claims unless separately proven in current implementation; do not promote them to implementation facts without repo/runtime evidence.

correction_history.change: Corrected prior over-compression of L1o and recorded early/final role names.
Added direct paragraph lineage, L600 reframed goals, Final Absolute Architecture stack, and authority rules separating design terminology from implementation truth.
